title: [Epic base] Shared by MCP ask and hosted ask: what the data and dataset tools return, and what they can read
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a coordination node under the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18. On the structure, verbatim: 「现在就改结构」; on what this parent restores, verbatim: 「你之前的公共底座不用优化吗」. This session had proposed a shared base and then left it out when it split the epic into lines; this card puts it back.

## What this is

The part of ask-data that belongs to no door. The open MCP door and the hosted product's own agent call the same framework tools; what those tools match, compute, return and say is decided once, here, for both.

**Order: first**, with line 1 (#35150): a card here is wanted by the MCP ask line now.

## What belongs here

- What a result carries: candidates, the next step, the citation line, fields withheld by field security, the query a figure came from, "not recorded", a capped page.
- When an ask-back is owed.
- What the tools can read in one call: groups ordered and cut, the latest row per group, related objects.

## What does not

- The ask-data skill, the text the open server sends, the size of its tool list: those are the open door's, on #35150.
- The product agent's prompt, planner and model: hosted.

## Why it is its own parent

Hosted ask does not wait for the open door's skill or instructions. It waits for exactly this: when the open children here have landed and the pin carries them, the hosted wrapper that computes the same things can be deleted (objectstack-ai/cloud#3825, objectstack-ai/cloud#4829). This card's state is that gate.

Landed work of this kind from before the split stays where it was hung, under #35150: `candidates` (#34761, #34763), the `nextStep` shape (#34918), labels in the caller's language (#34787, #34872, #34995).
